name: EGR Exploration Ltd
summary: EGR Exploration Ltd engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of resource properties in Canada. The company explores for rare earth metal, gold, platinum, and palladium deposits. It holds interest in the Hemlo Property located in Ontario; Urban Berry Property located in the Quebec; JAM Beryllium Property situated in the Northern British Columbia; Return Lake PGM Property located in the Quebec; and Wicheeda rare Earth Property located in British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Canadian Energy Materials Corp. and changed its name to EGR Exploration Ltd in February 2020. EGR Exploration Ltd was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
